_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): CSV export endpoint for an entity — composes comp-csv-exporter (to_csv_string) + comp-search-filter (search/sort parity with the list endpoint).
name: feature-export
description: CSV export endpoint: GET /{resource}s/export?search=&sort= streams every matching row (composes the csv exporter).

variables.name: resource_name
variables.description: Singular entity name, e.g. 'User' (must match the feature-crud resource)

variables.name: model_fields
variables.description: Comma-separated 'field:type' pairs — string fields become searchable, same as feature-crud

notes: Pairs with feature-crud: same search/sort semantics, exports ALL matching rows (no pagination). Frontend: comp-crud-page's Export button calls this endpoint (exportPath prop). TODO: register the router; add auth/admin protection via require_role when needed.
